_readme: Strain database for the storefront detail page. Keys are product names flattened (lowercase, (bracketed) words removed, punctuation removed) exactly like api/_menu.js flatName(). 'alias' maps alternative POS spellings to a canonical key. fillStrainInfo() in api/_menu.js fills type/thc/effects/flavors/description on weed products that arrive without them; /api/strain-info serves the same data to the browser and tries a live web lookup for strains not in this file. Add new strains here any time - facts from leafly.com/allbud.com, description in your own words.

zooties.name: Zooties
zooties.lineage: Grape Ape x Grapefruit x The Original Z x Gelato
zooties.desc: A potent, dessert-style hybrid from a multi-strain candy lineage, Zooties layers sweet berry and grape flavors over a heady euphoria that eases into deep body relaxation. Its high THC makes it a favorite for evening unwinding.

ztupid.name: Ztupid
ztupid.desc: A potent cross with a funky twist — candy and gas on the nose, fruity doughy notes underneath, and a sensory high that lifts without racing. Grown in the trick house.

zkittlez.name: Zkittlez
zkittlez.desc: This award-winning indica-leaning hybrid is prized for its rainbow of sweet fruit flavors reminiscent of the candy it is named after. The effect is calm and soothing, easing the body toward rest while keeping the mind pleasantly content.

cookiemonster.name: Cookie Monster
cookiemonster.lineage: Girl Scout Cookies x OG Kush
cookiemonster.desc: An indica cross of Girl Scout Cookies and OG Kush, Cookie Monster gives off a sweet, buttery aroma and a heavy, couch-locking calm. It suits nighttime use and stimulating the appetite.

crunchberries.name: Crunch Berries
crunchberries.desc: A Blueberry-derived hybrid with a bright, fruity berry profile, Crunch Berries tends to spark conversation and a cheerful mood before settling into gentle relaxation. Its moderate potency keeps the experience approachable.

alienmint.name: Alien Mint
alienmint.lineage: Alien OG x Girl Scout Cookies
alienmint.desc: A high-octane balanced hybrid crossing Alien OG and Girl Scout Cookies, Alien Mint pairs a cool minty-chocolate flavor with a very strong, uplifting yet calming buzz. Its elevated THC makes it best for experienced users.

dlish.name: D-Lish
dlish.desc: A balanced Zkittlez cross, D-Lish blends candy-fruit sweetness with a diesel edge and delivers an energetic, creative head lift that mellows into relaxation. Its potent THC gives it appeal for daytime creativity.

ogkush.name: OG Kush
ogkush.desc: A legendary West Coast hybrid, OG Kush is known for its earthy, piney, fuel-forward aroma and a powerful, stress-melting calm. It is a foundational strain behind countless modern crosses.

ogkushxzkittlez.name: OG Kush x Zkittlez
ogkushxzkittlez.desc: This hybrid marries OG Kush's classic potency with Zkittlez's fruity candy sweetness, yielding berry and tropical flavors alongside an upbeat, energizing euphoria for a lively but balanced experience.

blackcherry.name: Black Cherry
blackcherry.lineage: Acai Berry Gelato x Black Cherry Funk
blackcherry.desc: A dessert hybrid in the Black Cherry Gelato line, offering rich berry and stone-fruit sweetness with a relaxing, mood-lifting calm suited to easygoing afternoons.

orangez.name: Orange Z
orangez.desc: A citrus-forward hybrid crossing Zkittlez with Agent Orange, Orange Z bursts with bright orange and tropical flavors and delivers an uplifting, energetic mood boost that works well for daytime enjoyment.

whitelotus.name: White Lotus
whitelotus.desc: Balanced hybrid of The White and Snow Lotus whose frosty buds give off a tart citrus-pineapple edge. The high settles into easygoing relaxation and a gently euphoric mood.

giraffepuzzy.name: Giraffe Puzzy
giraffepuzzy.desc: Hype-heavy US hybrid popularized through the Doja Pak and Seed Junky collaboration, known for sticky, sauce-drenched buds. Buttery, fruity smoke with a diesel edge fuels a giggly, up-tempo buzz.

bluenerdz.name: Blue Nerdz
bluenerdz.desc: Candy-shop hybrid whose blueberry-apple sweetness rides over subtle earthy undertones. Delivers an even-keeled, focused euphoria rather than a heavy slide into the couch.

thaiorangetea.name: Thai Orange Tea
thaiorangetea.desc: Thai iced tea in a jar — orange and cream over a sweet base. Sativa, and it lifts without racing: the daytime pick for getting things done or making something.

redhotcookies.name: Red Hot Cookies
redhotcookies.desc: Sativa-leaning cross of Tropicanna Cookies with a red-flowering Tangie phenotype. Juicy citrus-berry flavor carries a bright, motivating lift that suits daytime sessions.

cocochanel.name: CoCo Chanel
cocochanel.desc: Coconut and vanilla with a citrus lift — the most easy-going jar on the shelf. Sativa-leaning at 70%, so the euphoria stays sociable instead of racy. Beach days and long conversations.

sherbtang.name: Sherb Tang
sherbtang.lineage: Sherb Cream Pie x Super Boof
sherbtang.desc: An indica-heavy pairing of Sherb Cream Pie and Super Boof. Creamy vanilla-berry smoke eases into deep evening relaxation without total couch-lock.

kingcherry.name: King Cherry
kingcherry.desc: A royal cherry cross with a gassy finish. Deep cherry and berry over fuel and floral notes, and a heavy 28% that settles into the body rather than the head — an evening jar, grown in the Royal Gardens.

pinkzugar.name: Pink Zugar
pinkzugar.desc: An indica-forward cross of Pink Pellegrino and Zuchi. Sugary berry-and-orchard-fruit flavor comes with a soothing body melt that keeps the mood bright.

babycakes.name: Baby Cakes
babycakes.desc: A potent, evenly balanced cross of Cake Boss and BaBo. Dessert-like vanilla-citrus flavor accompanies a warm, sociable calm that reliably wakes up the appetite.

mellowz.name: Mellowz
mellowz.desc: A cross of Spritzer and Grape Gas that tastes like candied marshmallow with a buttery finish. Despite its indica lean, the high stays mellow yet focused and upbeat.

superboof.name: Super Boof
superboof.lineage: Black Cherry Punch x Tropicana Cookies
superboof.desc: A Black Cherry Punch and Tropicana Cookies cross that pairs loud grapefruit-citrus flavor with a giggly, clear-headed buzz — one of the most talked-about strains of recent years.

rs11.name: RS11
rs11.desc: Rainbow Sherbert #11 comes from Pink Guava and Sunset Sherbert, offering soft stone-fruit flavors and a mellow, grin-inducing high that leaves focus intact.

lcgrx11.name: LCG RX11
lcgrx11.desc: A boutique cross of Lemon Cherry Gelato and RS11: dessert-citrus and sherbet fruit flavors with a relaxed yet functional buzz.

toadvenom.name: Toad Venom
toadvenom.lineage: Venom OG x All Gas OG
toadvenom.desc: Despite the menacing name, this hybrid of Venom OG and All Gas OG leans energizing and creative, with heavy fuel and cheesy funk in the smoke.

lemoncherrygelato.name: Lemon Cherry Gelato
lemoncherrygelato.desc: A Cookies-family favorite blending GSC with Sunset Sherbet; sweet lemon-berry gas up front, then a tingly, easygoing relaxation suited to evening sessions.

gelatox.name: Gelato X
gelatox.desc: An indica-leaning pairing of Runtz and Thin Mint GSC that tastes like minty vanilla dessert and settles users into a happy, sociable calm.

pineappleexpress.name: Pineapple Express
pineappleexpress.desc: The film-famous Trainwreck and Hawaiian cross delivers juicy tropical pineapple flavor with a bright, talkative energy that works well for daytime use.

thailanddurian.name: Thailand Durian
thailanddurian.desc: A durian-scented cultivar grown locally for the Thai market. Sweet, tropical and gently relaxing, with the fruit's signature richness in the aroma.

mac1.name: Mac 1
mac1.desc: Miracle Alien Cookies #1 crosses Alien Cookies F2 with Miracle 15 for a balanced, resin-caked hybrid known for buttery, sharp citrus smoke and a smooth euphoric lift.

grapestank.name: Grape Stank
grapestank.desc: Ripe grape over a sweet diesel base, and the body goes first. A true indica for winding down at the end of the night rather than starting anything.

lemoncherrybx2.name: Lemon Cherry BX2
lemoncherrybx2.desc: A second backcross of Lemon Cherry Gelato that sharpens the original's cherry-candy and lemon-zest profile while pushing potency higher, opening euphoric before easing into body calm.

lemoncherrysoap.name: Lemon Cherry Soap
lemoncherrysoap.lineage: The Soap x Lemon Cherry Gelato
lemoncherrysoap.desc: An indica-leaning cross of The Soap and Lemon Cherry Gelato, layering minty floral fruit over a heavy, tingly body calm that builds toward couch time.

partypopper.name: Party Popper
partypopper.desc: A boutique Runtz x Blumosa cut with a candy-shop nose and a gassy floral edge; the high settles into peaceful, heavy-lidded euphoria best saved for later in the day.

sfvxadl.name: SFV x ADL
sfvxadl.desc: A house cross built on SFV OG's fuel-and-pine backbone. Limited-run Thai-grown exotic — ask the budtender about today's cut.

zourz.name: Zour Z
zourz.desc: Sour Diesel crossed with Zkittlez: a lemon-fuel sativa leaner that lifts mood and nudges creativity without heavy sedation.

chocolatecrip.name: Chocolate Crip
chocolatecrip.desc: A house exotic with a roasty cocoa edge over earthy flower. Limited-run Thai-grown cut with details at the counter.

designermarker11.name: Designer Marker11
designermarker11.desc: A designer cross in the Permanent Marker / RS11 family grown for the Thai market. Sharp candy-funk nose and a strong, relaxing finish.

durbanz.name: Durban Z
durbanz.desc: Durban Poison crossed with Zkittlez yields a fast-acting daytime sativa; expect clear-headed lemon-candy energy that keeps both hands and mind busy.

durianpop.name: Durian Pop
durianpop.desc: A Thai signature exotic named for the king of fruits — rich, creamy funk in the aroma with a mellow tropical sweetness on the exhale.

emergenc.name: Emergen C
emergenc.lineage: Orange Push Pop x Sunset Sherbet
emergenc.desc: An orange-drenched hybrid that works like its namesake vitamin fizz: bright, chatty, focused energy over a juicy citrus taste.

permanentbx1.name: Permanent Bx1
permanentbx1.lineage: (Sherb Bx x Permanent Marker) x Permanent Marker
permanentbx1.desc: A backcross that doubles down on Permanent Marker genetics, pushing the soapy candy-gas funk even harder while the high stays deeply relaxing with a tingly edge.

pineapplebang.name: Pineapple Bang
pineapplebang.desc: A young release pairing Pineapple Fruz with Wild Cherry; early reports lean lively and focused with a quirky mix of tropical fruit, diesel, and mint.

pressure.name: Pressure
pressure.desc: A rare Gary Payton x Rainbow Chip cross: peppery citrus smoke up front, then a calm, happy stretch of creative headspace.

teatime.name: Tea Time
teatime.desc: A heavy-hitting Z x RS11 hybrid that opens with fizzy, upbeat energy and candy-citrus sweetness before easing into a soft full-body wind-down.

wildcherry.name: Wild Cherry
wildcherry.desc: A cherry-forward sativa leaner from Cherry Thunderfuck and Trainwreck that keeps the mood giggly and bright while the body stays comfortably loose.

gemsnowpineappleexpress.name: Gem Snow Pineapple Express
gemsnowpineappleexpress.desc: A branded Thai-market cut of the classic Pineapple Express, serving the famous Trainwreck x Hawaiian recipe of juicy pineapple-citrus flavor and buzzy, cheerful daytime energy.

thesoap.name: The Soap
thesoap.desc: A cross of Animal Mints with Kush Mints; a clean, energizing smoke with an unusual perfume of mint, rose, and tea.

grapegasoline.name: Grape Gasoline
grapegasoline.desc: Grape candy over a hard fuel funk, and it arrives fast. A sativa-leaning exotic the shop keeps for daytime — the one to reach for before a workout rather than after one.

wilsonzero.name: Wilson Zero
wilsonzero.desc: Bright citrus with a cool menthol finish, at the highest THC on the shelf. The high is spacey but stays pointed — made for late-night gaming and music.

strawberrydrip.name: Strawberry Drip
strawberrydrip.desc: Fresh strawberry and candy sweetness on a true sativa. Bright, lifting energy with no heaviness behind it — a weekend-adventure strain.

whitegarlic.name: White Garlic
whitegarlic.desc: Savoury garlic over herb and spice, indica-leaning and heavy-lidded. The slow rainy-afternoon end of the menu.

garlicman.name: Garlic Man
garlicman.desc: Pungent garlic and savoury diesel — one of the loudest jars in the shop. A playful, giggly buzz that stays clear rather than couch-locking.

papayafuel.name: Papaya Fuel
papayafuel.desc: Tropical papaya cut with diesel, and the strongest flower in the shop at 33.5%. An energising rush with a creative edge — a morning strain, not an evening one.

granddaddypurple.name: Granddaddy Purple
granddaddypurple.desc: The classic purple indica — grape and berry over damp earth, and full-body sedation behind it. Movie nights, then deep sleep.

gelato41.name: Gelato 41
gelato41.desc: Dessert-style exotic — creamy and sweet, the Gelato family at its most indulgent.

limehooties.name: Lime Hooties
limehooties.desc: Zesty lime and citrus over a funky base. A balanced hybrid that relaxes without flattening you — the one that suits any hour and any company.
